text.card: A red giant 10,204 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 2.77 solar masses and 18.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,044 K at its surface.
